#b[Home] Story Quests can only be completed by one of your characters on each world. You cannot complete the quest on another character once started.
QuestInfo.1: On the back of the postcard Alvin and Amy's parents sent was a picture with palm trees and old-style buildings with a beach in the background. Odds are good the photo was taken at either Lith Harbor, Gold Beach Resort, or Commerci. Since Lith Harbor is closest, it seems like a good place to start your search.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in Lith Harbor. Go to Tru the Information Dealer and ask about the postcard.
